doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Optimism and current projects
summary: She is an optimist, writing 'The Green World' and a Bliss piece with Bill Elliot for Barbara Hannigan.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah. I am. I think I’ve said many times I believe the best part of life can come at any moment.
Nice. And when we wrap this up, do you have a project that you will turn to that’s sort of in the works?

I have a couple of things in the works. Well I’m doing a new album which is called “The Green World” and I have about half of the songs almost done, not recorded but written. And I’m working on something that — I shouldn’t say the title yet because I’m not entirely sure, but Bill Elliot, who used to have a big band when I was in L.A. and has written a couple of songs with me, was working with the soprano, conductor Barbara Hannigan who is this extraordinary eccentric woman who sings opera and conducts. She won the Gramophone Award for Artist of the Year last year. And Bill was going to London to record an adaptation he did of John Lithgow’s book “The Remarkable Farkle McBride” re-titled “The Remarkable Sparkle McBride” for Barbara. And he had room for something else so he said maybe we should write something. And actually no what happened was I called him and I said, “Are you still working with Barbara Hannigan?” Because a mutual friend of ours had said you and Bill should write something for Barbara. And I happened to call him exactly as he was sort of thinking about that. So we wrote a 15-minute piece based on Catherine Manfield’s short story “Bliss” which is about a young woman who falls in love with another woman in her social circle. It’s got a surprise ending. It’s very dramatic, was perfectly suited for an opera, and we recorded it and videotaped it with the BBC orchestra and Barbara conducting and singing. And it came off really well, so we’re working on something else, Bill and I. And those are my two main projects right now, although there are some others kind of in the wings too.
